visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white furry trapper hat and a white fleece jacket, stands in a museum exhibit designed to look like a cave with reddish-brown, jagged rock walls. She faces the camera, speaking with expressive facial movements. (2) She turns and walks deeper into the dim cave tunnel. As she moves, she suddenly flinches and jumps back, her mouth open in a surprised expression. (3) The camera cuts to a man wearing a black beanie and a blue jacket with two action cameras mounted on his chest. He is smiling and rubbing the top of his head while standing under a low rock ceiling. (4) The woman walks through a large cavern filled with numerous stalactites and stalagmites that are illuminated by intense red and green artificial spotlights, creating a high-contrast environment. (5) A golden Buddha statue is shown in a close-up; it is seated and holding several pieces of paper currency between its fingers. (6) The woman stands in front of a complex rock formation that resembles slices of raw, marbled meat on a display stand. (7) An elaborate, large-scale wood carving of a mountain landscape with intricate trees, pagodas, and many tiny figures is showcased. The woman stands beside it to show the scale. (8) A large skeletal reconstruction of a mammoth is displayed in a brightly lit gallery room. (9) The man points toward a wall display case filled with hundreds of small colorful figurines and action figures arranged in neat rows.

(2) A sudden, dull percussive thud is heard, immediately followed by a loud, high-pitched vocal shriek from the woman. The BGM continues uninterrupted. (3) The male voice enters with a mid-pitched, laughing tone, speaking at a moderate conversational rate. The female voice responds quickly with high arousal and playful indignation. (4) The BGM maintains its tempo. The voices have a slight acoustic reverb consistent with an indoor museum gallery. Rapid speech exchanges occur with quick hard cuts in the audio track. (5) A cartoon-style 'whoosh' sound effect plays during a visual transition. The female voice lowers slightly in pitch as she comments on the golden statue. (6) The vocal density remains high as the two speakers narrate their observations of various wood carvings and exhibits, maintaining a comedic and lighthearted tone until the end.
